nodes.name: ErrorAlertConfig
nodes.notes: Centralized error alert configuration: replace <SLACK_ERROR_CHANNEL_ID> with the channel ID of #order-status-drafter-alerts.

parameters.content:
## 01 — Receive & configure error alert
Accept native workflow error events or synthetic callable test payloads, converge into a single input envelope, and set the destination Slack alert channel ID.

## 02 — Parse, sanitize & deliver Slack alert
Classify the failure, allowlist and redact fields through the shared error policy, post the alert to Slack with bounded retries, and return the delivery receipt.
